_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 0b24c745 (a query constant keeps its base direction; the direction is bound to ITS literal, not to its language) and ems__Bug 97ebe042 (a language-tagged constant is the language-tagged literal; `=` / `!=` compare the language tag and direction of any literal). Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> `. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted. Subject: constantTerm builds a directional constant's exact term; an unbuildable constant's identity includes its direction.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/filters/FunctionRegistry.ts

F1_constant_term_without_direction._note: sameTerm's view of a constant drops the direction (the evaluated value keeps it — T10 stays green).
F1_constant_term_without_direction.from: if (node.language) return new Literal(lexical, undefined, node.language, node.direction);
F1_constant_term_without_direction.to: if (node.language) return new Literal(lexical, undefined, node.language);

F2_unbuildable_key_without_direction._note: ""@ar--rtl and ""@ar — terms the engine cannot build — become the same identity.
F2_unbuildable_key_without_direction.from: JSON.stringify([node.namedNode === true, lexical, node.datatype ?? null, node.language ?? null, node.direction ?? null]),
F2_unbuildable_key_without_direction.to: JSON.stringify([node.namedNode === true, lexical, node.datatype ?? null, node.language ?? null]),

F3_string_functions_drop_tag._note: Every string function returns the bare text again (review finding 2: `=` now compares the tag, so LCASE(?o) = ?o would be false).
F3_string_functions_drop_tag.from: return new Literal(result, undefined, arg.language, arg.direction);
F3_string_functions_drop_tag._note_review: Axes added at the specification stage (11.11): T23 — SUBSTR with a length is one of the string functions this mutant strips.

F4_concat_direction_ignored._note: CONCAT keeps the tag when the languages agree, whatever the directions.
F4_concat_direction_ignored.from: (v) => v instanceof Literal && v.language === first.language && v.direction === first.direction,

F5_concat_first_argument_only._note: CONCAT takes the first argument's tag without looking at the others.
F5_concat_first_argument_only.from: (v) => v instanceof Literal && v.language === first.language && v.direction === first.direction,

F6_string_result_without_direction._note: A string function keeps the language but drops the direction.
F6_string_result_without_direction.from: return new Literal(result, undefined, arg.language, arg.direction);

F7_substr_with_length_drops_tag._note: Review of the specification (11.11, MU1): SUBSTR with a length argument returns the bare substring — every axis before T23 stayed green.
